4. The account that receives the minted tokens is determined by the function parameter '_to', which can be any address specified by the caller, thus allowing the owner to mint tokens to any address they choose.
5. Since the owner can mint tokens to any address without any restrictions on the amount, this behavior fits the definition of MINT.
